Our Innovation
RailDost

Your AI travel companion across every Indian language

An AI-powered web application built to eliminate language barriers for anyone traveling on Indian Railways. India's rail network carries over 23 million passengers every day across a country with 24 official languages. Whether you're a foreign tourist struggling to read a platform sign, or a domestic traveler in an unfamiliar region, Raildost translates the world around you in real time.

Using Google Gemini for translation, ElevenLabs for voice, and Supabase for secure authentication, Raildost gives every traveler five powerful ways to understand and communicate — through text, voice, camera, live speech, and a smart railway chatbot — all in one place.

What it does

Key Features

📝
Text Translation
Type or paste anything — a sign, a notice, a message — and get an instant translation across 24 languages. Hear it read aloud with one tap.
🎙️
Voice Translation
Speak and get a spoken reply in another language. Two-way mode lets you have a real back-and-forth conversation, swapping languages automatically each turn.
📷
Camera Translation
Photograph any printed or handwritten text — tickets, menus, station boards — and Gemini reads and translates it in a single step. No separate scanner needed.
🔴
Live Translation
Hold your phone up to a live announcement and watch the translation appear in real time, with smart 700ms debouncing for smooth output.
🤖
RailMate Chat
Ask anything about Indian rail travel — coach classes, Tatkal booking, waitlists, food safety, solo travel tips — and get a clear answer in your language.
🔐
Secure Authentication
Powered by Supabase, RailDost ensures your travel history and preferences are stored securely with enterprise-grade authentication and session management.
